items.text: **Fade in and fade out for video.** The Record sheet has two new rows on Video: **Fade in** (none, .5 s, 1 s, 2 s; default .5 s) and **Fade out** (none, 1 s, 2 s, 4 s; default 2 s). The sound rises at the start instead of starting at full level, and falls over the length you choose; a second tap on stop ends at once. With a fixed length, the fade finishes at that length.

**Notches in the right place.** Next, Air and the line-up button now carry the same top-left notch as the robot and the other pop-up buttons. **Air has a pop-up:** press and hold it for the six cloud looks and the three loop-grain settings; a tap still opens the Air pad.
The undo and redo pill sits a little closer to the bar beside it.

**The dice arrow in the Grain halo now does something.** Tap the small arrow on the dice square and choose **With main dice** (this note rolls its own dice every time the score's dice roll, including Auto) or **By hand** (only when you tap its dice). By hand is the default; a note that is tied shows a ring round its dice square.

**A video ends on your mark.** When you stop (or the time runs out), the picture and the recorded sound fade to black, the Dimitry Saïd Chamy lockup fades in, Dimitry and Chamy move apart, Saïd falls away, all three leave the frame and CHAMY·XYZ appears. It adds about five and a half seconds. Tap stop again to end at once.
**Branding on or off.** A switch in the record and share sheets: CHAMY·XYZ (the word and equalizer under the picture, and the ending) or clean (nothing added). It is remembered.
**Files are numbered:** CHAMY·XYZ_000001, 000002 and so on, in this browser, for videos, GIFs, pictures, sound and notes.
**Steadier sound while recording a video.** The frame is now drawn 30 times a second instead of at every screen refresh (up to 120 on some iPads), which was the likely cause of the crackle you heard.
**Under a video, GIF or picture: the CHAMY·XYZ word and an equalizer, instead of the tool's name.** The word sits at the left; beside it, one bar for each column of the grid moves with what you hear.

**A sound loop now joins itself without a click.** Held notes, the grain air and the room keep sounding from one pass to the next, so the old fold doubled them for a few seconds at the start and left a jump at the seam. Now one pass plays first as a warm-up, then the next passes are recorded, and the sound that comes after them is crossfaded into the start.

**The record button shows how long is left.** A recording that ends by itself (a loop, a batch, a timed take or video, a GIF) draws a ring round the record button that fills as it goes. A recording that only ends when you say so turns the button into a **stop** square.
The label at the top is short now: **Loop recording · 1:20 left**. For a loop its button says **cancel**, because a loop ends by itself.

**The Grain halo is the same halo you use to add marks.** Double-tap a held note and the same frame of squares opens around it, with the note in the middle and the name above: 4, 8 and 16 slices, off, the four patterns (steady, swing, stutter, scramble), and the dice underneath. It replaces the ring of dots from 0.9.68.
Escape closes the halo without letting go of your held notes.

**The Grain controls are now a real halo.** Double-tap a held note and a ring of dots opens around it: slices (off, 4, 8, 16), pattern (steady, swing, stutter, scramble) and a **dice** dot. Small ticks on the note show the pattern and light up as it plays.
**The dice now always change the sound.** Before, on Steady they rolled a pattern that was identical, so nothing seemed to happen. Now each roll picks a different pattern and a new shuffle.
The notch on the Next button is no longer cut off by the rounded end of the bar.
Housekeeping: no change to how anything sounds or looks.
